verdict.rationale: Better Auth's MCP plugin is documented as letting your app act as an OAuth authorization server and protected resource for Model Context Protocol clients, which is the core of putting OAuth in front of an MCP server. The homepage also markets 'MCP auth, token exchange, and agent delegation', and the JWT plugin exposes a JWKS endpoint for verifying tokens. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of scoped token issuance and enforcement, details of spec compliance (e.g. metadata discovery, dynamic client registration, PKCE), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP OAuth flow.
